location_qualifier: Lunga / Guadalcanal, with the 132nd RCT less 1st Battalion
source_locator: R2225: ch. IX, p. 213; R2227: Part VI, ch. 9
notes: The 132nd RCT (less the 1st Battalion and A Battery, 247th Field Artillery) landed on 8 December 1942 (Miller, ch. IX). The 3rd Battalion led the later Mount Austen attack and is treated as having landed with that RCT. Confidence 0.7, matching the existing regiment landing claim C12814 (Miller and Hough, Ludwig and Shaw).

current_activity: attacking into the jungle on the Mount Austen crest from Hill 35
notes: Miller, ch. X: early on 18 December L Company led the 3rd Battalion from the Hill 35 road terminus into the jungle on the Mount Austen crest; the main body joined at 1130 and the battalion established a perimeter just inside the jungle. Commander Lt. Col. William C. Wright. Confidence 0.5: one official family. Matches regiment claim C12913.

location_qualifier: west of Hill 35, on the Mount Austen crest
current_activity: failing to gain ground after Colonel Wright was killed
notes: Miller, ch. X: on 19 December Lt. Col. William C. Wright was hit about 0930 while reconnoitering west of the 3rd Battalion line and died shortly after noon. The battalion failed to gain ground that day. Confidence 0.5: one official family. Zimmerman, ch. IX, also records Wright's death on 19 December but places the action on the northern slopes of Hill 27, so this row is not raised to 0.7.

location_qualifier: Hill 31 and the ravine toward the Gifu
current_activity: reaching Hill 31 and being halted by machine-gun fire from the Gifu
notes: Miller, ch. X: the 3rd Battalion left its area at 0730 on 24 December, reached Hill 31, and on the open slopes was halted by heavy machine-gun fire from the Gifu. Matches regiment claim C12914. Confidence 0.5: one official family.
